data.description: 【铃兰 · 庭院晨曦】清晨薄雾初散的罗德岛温室花园内，身穿洁白连衣裙的九尾小狐狸丽萨轻轻提起裙摆穿梭在花丛间，身后九条蓬松硕大的金色狐尾在晨光中欢快摆动。她转过身露出世间最纯洁治愈的微笑——「博士，早上好！今天的花儿喝饱了露水，开得特别漂亮呢！」
data.promptProse: Suzuran walks between the greenhouse flower beds in a white garden dress, lifting its hem just enough to clear the plants. All nine golden tails sway behind her as she turns with a cheerful smile. The medium view shows glass panels rising beyond the flowers; soft morning light through them brightens her ears and dress, while lingering mist and gentle plant shadows separate the beds.
data.title: 铃兰 · 庭院晨曦
